title: af/TaskStorageSweep@2
description: What the Storage Budget's sweep at the end of `af task run` removed and failed to remove (ADR-0144), recorded as an observation of the Task that run executed. Carried inline by one `storage_sweep` TaskTransition@5 that references no artifact; it never changes the Task's result. Bounded like a gate cleanup: at most 256 removals and 64 failures are listed and the rest only counted. A sweep that removed nothing and failed nothing records nothing; every other one is recorded, one whose total after it is unknown included: its `total_after` and its `stop` are then `unknown`, together. Version 2 is the first that can say `unknown` and that carries `freed_bytes`; the superseded af/TaskStorageSweep@1 is refused.

omitted_removals.description: Removals counted but not listed: beyond the 256 listed, with a path no record can name, or of a kind the record has none for, a Survey's (ADR-0159 clause 13).

freed_bytes.description: The allocated bytes that left the disk in this sweep: every removal's, listed or not, and what a removal that failed part way freed before it stopped, as far as it was measured.

stop.description: `fits`: the total fits the budget; `nothing_evictable`: still over it, and the rest is in use or was used within the hour; `unknown`: a removal stopped part way and what it left cannot be measured, so the total after the sweep is unknown.

total_after.description: af's total after the sweep, or `unknown` exactly when `stop` is `unknown`.

path.description: The entry's absolute path; for a finished Task, its Store.

task_id.description: The collected Task, for a `task` removal and only for one.
